title: An Assembly Elects the First Romanov
dek: Of how a land without a tsar called an assembly into a burned capital, passed over foreign princes and great boyars, and chose a sixteen-year-old.

panels.label: Romanovs Told It
panels.text: The whole land, moved by God, chose with one voice the nearest kin of the old dynasty, and peace returned with him.

panels.label: Evidence Allows
panels.text: Boyars, Cossacks and town delegates bargained for weeks. Michael won as the candidate who threatened the fewest factions, and his father ruled.
